vulnerability_title: Stale precompile data leads to incorrect pricing and loss for withdrawers

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: getUnderlyingSupply prices aHYPE from the contract balance plus the DelegatorSummary and spot balance precompiles, and withdraw uses it to fix the withdrawal price. processQueues sends HYPE to HyperCore, and the precompile values only change in the next block, so a withdraw in the same block uses a wrong price.
patterns_found: precompile balances read in the same block after funds are sent to HyperCore
withdrawal price fixed from stale balances

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: stale precompile balances in the same block give a wrong withdrawal price
